## Capability and mathematical contract

Link the milestone and notes. State targets, dimensions, basis, units, and observation assumptions.

## Expected behavior and acceptance

Describe inputs, outputs, invariants, and an independent reference calculation. Include relevant PSD/trace, adjoint, geometry, or error checks.

## Reproduction

Provide configuration, seed, commands, tolerances, and expected artifacts. Separate statistical and numerical errors.

## Limitations

State unresolved assumptions and which broader claims this implementation does not establish.
